why: A 2026 arXiv paper by Pavelescu, Pavelescu and Potter, 'New minor minimal non-apex graphs,' proves that every simple graph on 13 vertices with minimum degree 6 is apex or contains a K6 minor, settling the order-13 case of Jorgensen's conjecture.

found.note: Preprint by Pavelescu, Pavelescu, Potter; proves the order-13 minimum-degree-6 case of Jorgensen's conjecture, plus lists forbidden minors for apex graphs with ≤12 vertices or ≤26 edges. Not read in full.
